name: tiabete
description: TiaBete – controle de glicemia para diabetes MODY (app local, sem conta, sem nuvem)

scripts.test: node tests/test.js && node tests/test2.js && node tests/test3.js && node tests/test4.js && node tests/test5.js
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:web && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && node scripts/patch-android.js && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --assetPath assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
